name: Elemental Familiar

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Your familiar resists Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder (your pick), and as a Bonus Action you can have it spend its Reaction to burst with that energy, hurting and toppling the creatures beside it.

benefits.name: Elemental Nature
benefits.summary: Your familiar has Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder damage (your pick).
benefits.text: Pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Thunder: your familiar has Resistance to that damage. The book has you pick each time you cast Find Familiar; the game lets you change the pick after a Long Rest.

benefits.name: Elemental Burst
benefits.summary: Bonus Action: your familiar within 120 feet spends its Reaction; each creature within 5 feet of it makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d4 damage of the picked type, and a Medium or smaller one falls Prone.
benefits.text: As a Bonus Action you can command your familiar, if it's within 120 feet of you, to spend its Reaction releasing a surge of its element. Each other creature within 5 feet of the familiar makes a Dexterity saving throw against 8 + the spellcasting modifier you use for Find Familiar + your Proficiency Bonus. On a failed save it takes 2d4 damage of the type you picked, and if it's Medium or smaller it also falls Prone.
